caller_says: Allô ? Oui, je suis dans ma chambre, au troisième, avec mon fils.
Il y a de la fumée sous la porte, on n'ose pas sortir.
expected_crew: Appel Léa Martin : deux personnes chambre 3.12, fumée sous la porte, restent sur place.
agent_says_to_caller: Restez chez vous, porte fermée. Ne prenez pas l'escalier, il est enfumé. Calfeutrez le bas de la porte avec un linge mouillé. Les pompiers sont informés de votre position. Restez en ligne.
note: The stay-put advice above is a STANDING INSTRUCTION: at incident start Seraph asks the COS « Consigne par défaut aux occupants : si fumée dans l'escalier ou devant la porte, rester chez soi, porte fermée. Confirmez ? » (gate relay_order). Only once confirmed may call agents say it, and only to a caller at home (current_action staying) who reports smoke. Without that confirmation the agent says only « Restez en ligne, je transmets aux pompiers. » Every other instruction goes through the commander, flat by flat. « Levée du confinement » (radio R14) lifts it for everyone. Floors are counted the French way: ground floor = RDC = 0, « second floor » = R+2. The room id comes from the occupant record when the caller names their floor and the kind of room.

after_confirm_agent_says: The firefighters ask you to go back into your flat now and close the door. Do not use the stairs, there is smoke. Go out on your balcony so the firefighters can see you. Stay on the line.

after_confirm.say_crew: Reçu. Tom Becker reste chez lui, balcon 2.17 : point échelle.

note: One stair (stair:A), in smoke: no other stair to give. The balcony is the ladder point of his flat (units U2.2: outdoor 2.17) reachable from his room 2.16 (French window P2-69), chosen by code. voice_note: The voice case: the facts alone give 2 (in the building, no smoke); fear in her voice raises it to 3.
